linkedin:
Remote teams and families spread across time zones have the same problem: staying in touch without another notification.

Friendship Lamps are a simple answer. Touch your lamp and the paired lamp lights up in someone else's home, over each home's own Wi-Fi, so distance doesn't matter. 256 colors and app scheduling.

Lumi starts at $70 (reg. $109), Classic and Modern from $99, Mid-Century from $118 (prices at time of writing). One thing to check first: both homes need 2.4GHz Wi-Fi.

A thoughtful gift for a distributed team or family. Details in the first comment.
